procedural_matters: The Race Committee was represented by Jan Prockat.
The protestee did not attend the hearing, the hearing proceeds under 63.1(b).
facts: The Race committeevessels returned ashore at 1600 hrs. and lodged the protest 30 minutes later.
There was nonotice on the notice board, nor was the sailor informed in any way, before the hearingschedule was posted.
conclusions: The Race Committee failed todeliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3.
The Race Committee failed toinform the protestee of his intention to protest as required by RRS 60.2(a)(2).
There was no good reason toextend the time limit.
